problems: The closing ORDO RERUM prints no column per item in this OCR; a detached block of 13 digit strings (1050 105i 1061 1110 1130 1112 11759 1211 125) 1990 129i 1310 1319) follows it but cannot be assigned to items without the body. Every colStatus is therefore body-only. The block is consistent with body pages found for Andronici (1049-50), Lucae (1129), Abercii (1211), Zenobii (1309-10), Epimachi (1319) but this is not used as confirmation.
Vita sancti Theophanis (Die 12 Martii): OCR opens at col 11 mid-text; head not in the OCR. bodyCol null, unlocated.

bodyCol is the odd (left) column of the page on which the first head of the item sits, per the brief; where an item opens with a Bollandist preface (DE SANCTO ...) that preface is the first head and is used, with the Greek/Latin text head described in note. Where the ordo item may intend the text head instead, the page can differ by a few columns.

OCR page duplication: cols ~461-490 appear twice (lines ~31351-33364 and ~33436-35160), so Eudocimi has two heads (33258 and 34974); first given. Cols ~575-590 and ~585-600 region (lines ~41565-45700) likewise repeat Pauli et Juliae / Andreae heads (second copies at 43553/43673 and 44247/44544); first given.

Dionysius Areopagita appears in the body (col 1031-1048) but not in the ordo OCR; added as an extra entry. Demetrii is listed in the ordo as Vide tomum sequentem; recorded as crossref (volume 116 inferred from 'tomum sequentem'; no column given). Body shows only a short note at col 1031.

Detached/stray ordo fragments: 'Die 8 ... Vita et Acta varia' preceded by a stray '100.' line; days missing for several July/Aug items (OCR dropped 'Die 18/19...' prefixes); the ordo's 'Gallinci' is Callinici in the body.

Greek flag for items opening with only a Latin preface (Philippi, XLV, Andreae et sociorum, Eudoxii, Cypriani, Andreae Cretensis) is based on Greek text seen later in the item, not at the first head. Oratio de Maria prints Latin only with Greek fragments subjoined.

Several Elenchus-less heads were placed from nearest page-header numbers (OCR garbled: 4127, 441, 989|990, 743, 133|794, 516 ...); pg-colfind chain lags in cols 100-800, so bodyCol here comes from header numbers, not the chain.
